nodes.name: Save Ticket (never skipped)
nodes.notes: This write happens before any AI touches the ticket. If everything downstream fails, the ticket still exists.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO ticket_photos (ticket_id, seq, filename, stored_path, public_url, mime_type, bytes)
SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7
WHERE $2 > 0
ON CONFLICT (ticket_id, seq) DO NOTHING;

SELECT ticket_id, title, venue, category, severity, raw_description, created_at
FROM tickets
WHERE status IN ('new','open','blocked')
  AND ticket_id <> $1
  AND created_at > now() - interval '90 days'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 40;

nodes.name: AI Triage
nodes.notes: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint: Gemini, Groq, OpenCode Zen, OpenRouter, or a local model. Set TRIAGE_API_URL and TRIAGE_MODEL in the n8n env. If this fails the ticket still lands — it just arrives untriaged.

parameters.query:
UPDATE tickets SET
  title = $2, category = $3, severity = $4, gear_item = COALESCE($5, gear_item),
  duplicate_of = $6, triage_notes = $7, triage_model = $8,
  triaged_at = now(), status = 'open'
WHERE ticket_id = $1
RETURNING ticket_id;
